comparison.objective: Power on a bench supply, set its voltage knob to 9 V, and leave other controls and the unit unchanged.
comparison.physical_skill: Button pressing, knob grasping, precise wrist rotation, and arm retraction; no striking or fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Supply on, voltage within 0.2 V, knob released, other controls within 3 degrees, supply within pose tolerances, arms returned, and 1 s stillness; tipping/falling invalidates.
comparison.reason: The precision feedback task changes a control setting rather than causing a validated fracture while protecting a retained insert and recovering debris.
